summary: Bourne & Weir is a Melbourne CBD chartered accounting practice trusted for over 35 years, offering tax, advisory, SMSF and virtual CFO services. Luke Micallef is a Partner (since July 2021) focused on the strategic side of tax, structuring, and cash flow forecasting and budgeting. The firm publishes regular tax insight articles, most recently a May 2026 Federal Budget summary.
